root_cause.note: Scheduler debug mux mounts full pprof handler set.

evidence.analysis: Volcano scheduler mounts the complete /debug/pprof/* handler set on its debug mux when pprof scheduling options are enabled. Exposure is flag-gated, so it is a deployment posture (leak of heap/cpu profiles with scheduler state) rather than an always-on sink; the volcano agent DaemonSet (hostNetwork + hostPath elevated-pod-spec hits) is the paired posture finding.
